name: What are the steps to getting a beautiful, functional kitchen renovation?

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation & Design – This is where you meet with a contractor like Simply Construction in Las Vegas. We'll discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Our team will help you refine your ideas, suggest layouts, and explore material options. This phase often takes a few weeks, depending on how quickly decisions are made and designs are finalized. We ensure your goals align with practical solutions.

Our team will help you refine your ideas, suggest layouts, and explore material options. This phase often takes a few weeks, depending on how quickly decisions are made and designs are finalized. We ensure your goals align with practical solutions.

step.name: Step 2: Planning & Permits – Once the design is set, we move into detailed planning. This includes finalizing material selections, creating precise blueprints, and securing any necessary permits from the city of Las Vegas or Clark County. This step is crucial for compliance and safety and typically spans 2-4 weeks, as we navigate local regulations.

step.name: Step 3: Demolition & Structural Work – With permits in hand, the fun begins! We'll carefully remove old cabinets, flooring, and appliances. If your renovation involves structural changes, like opening up a wall or reconfiguring the layout, our skilled team will handle that safely and efficiently. This phase can take 1-2 weeks, depending on the complexity of the changes.

step.name: Step 4: Rough-Ins (Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC) – After demolition, the 'bones' of your new kitchen take shape. New plumbing lines, electrical wiring for outlets and lighting, and any HVAC adjustments are installed according to the new design. This meticulous work, often requiring various trades, usually lasts 1-2 weeks before inspections are conducted.

step.name: Step 5: Cabinet & Countertop Installation – This is where your kitchen really starts to look like a kitchen! Your chosen cabinets are professionally installed, followed by the precise measurement and installation of your countertops. This phase typically takes 1-3 weeks, with custom cabinets and unique countertop materials sometimes requiring more time.

step.name: Step 6: Flooring, Painting & Finishes – With the major components in place, we install new flooring, complete any necessary painting, and add the finishing touches like backsplashes, light fixtures, and appliance installation. This final stage typically wraps up in 1-2 weeks, bringing your vision to life. A professional general contractor coordinates all these steps, ensuring a cohesive and high-quality result.
